headline: $679 Million Left Bitcoin Exchanges as Spot Held Near 83k
narrative: Exchange netflow showed $679 million leaving Bitcoin venues over 24 hours, a 0.2489 percent decline in exchange-held value and a mild accumulation print. Cumulative volume delta sat in the 71st percentile of the past 30 days, a buy-side lean on the same tape. Bitcoin rose 0.77 percent and was changing hands near 83k, so coins were leaving venues into a higher spot price.
author: jordan
